evidence: Walked instruction.md and the six notes line by line against solution/app. No asked-for screen or flow is missing. Editor (ui.md): own DOM surface, a div role=textbox with a line/caret model and no textarea or contenteditable (custom-editor.js:19, 1086-1124); typing, paste, Enter, Backspace, Delete, arrows, Home/End, Shift-extend (261-348, 767-804); grapheme stepping (876-904); caret reveal (1127-1142); click, double, triple, drag (350-439); copy/cut (246-259); block indent/outdent incl. end-at-next-line-start (835-858); Alt/Ctrl/Cmd multi-carets with offset-based same-line typing and merged deletes (356-371, 584-602, 672-716); grouped undo, redo, disabled controls (209-234, 1147-1148); find/next/previous wrap, replace current, replace all (960-1084); JS and HTML colouring (101-180, style.css:24-30); Prettier format with error path that leaves the draft (79-100); line/column label (1091); Escape-then-Tab exit shown in the footer (263-269, 1156). Workspace (app.tsx): title/filename/Run/Stop/New/Save, library, read-only history, restore and retry (146-160); dirty marker (43, 142, 149); conflict and newer-revision notices that keep the draft (72, 140-152); 2 s library polling that only replaces the list (134-139); focus returned after Save (73). Runtime (runtime.ts): sandboxed iframe with connect-src 'none' (7, 376, 387); loop/timer/Promise budget and fresh budget on interaction (139-141, 231-282); last-good restore with control values and canvas pixels (8-24, 159-203, 375-403); line-numbered errors incl. HTML and unhandled rejections (46-49, 213-229, 288-357); dynamic import refused by AST, eval/Function/WASM/workers by CSP with mapped message (50-52, 220-227). Server (server.js): SQLite at DB_PATH or /app/app.db (8, 142-169), revision-checked save (52-59, 78-90), history (91-94), idempotent restore by operationId (95-119), health (12). Built bundle public/assets/index.js contains the probed src strings and public/index.html loads it. Scripted golden evidence (hashes verified; not a configured judge run, not the test.sh uid/DB_PATH launch path): 49 boolean results all true, pageErrors empty. Residual small golden deviations, none a missing deliverable: (a) custom-editor.js:137 colours only Identifier callees, so method calls such as console.log and class/object method names get no function colour against ui.md:13, visible on line 10 of golden-1440.png; (b) custom-editor.js:63-65 Enter in the Replace box replaces without returning focus to the code (ui.md:17), the Replace button path does (61); (c) custom-editor.js:792 vertical moves clamp by UTF-16 column and can land inside an emoji or combining sequence, after which Backspace (878, 890-897) removes half of it, against ui.md:5; preferredCol is also nulled after block indent (853); (d) custom-editor.js:344 inserts the letter for unhandled Ctrl/Cmd chords and drops AltGr characters. golden-390.png shows the preview pane with its background but no text although polish.cjs:118 asserted the frame text just before; most likely a full-page capture artefact of an out-of-process frame below the fold, not measured further.
counterexample: Not a coverage failure. Bounded golden deviations: line 1 'ab', line 2 starting with an emoji; caret at line 1 col 1, ArrowDown, Backspace leaves a lone surrogate. Find text, press Next, type a replacement and press Enter in the Replace box: focus stays in that box. `console.log(1)` shows `log` in the plain text colour.
suggested_fix: In moveCaret snap the clamped column to a grapheme boundary and keep preferredCol after indent; call editor.focus() after replaceCurrent in the Replace-box Enter handler; optionally colour MemberExpression property callees and method keys as functions; skip character insertion when ctrlKey or metaKey is held without AltGr. Rebuild the bundle and re-run the scripted golden.
